mapper.sql: SELECT cost_id, company_id, material_id, material_code, material_name, warehouse_id, location_id, batch_no, qty, unit_cost, total_cost, cost_method, source_module, source_type, source_id, inbound_order_id, last_in_date, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM fin_inventory_cost
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS totalQty, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) AS totalCost, CASE WHEN SUM(qty) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(total_cost) / SUM(qty), 4) END AS avgCost FROM fin_inventory_cost WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_inventory_cost ( material_id, material_code, material_name, warehouse_id, location_id, batch_no, qty, unit_cost, total_cost, cost_method, source_module, source_type, source_id, inbound_order_id, last_in_date, version, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{materialId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{warehouseId}, #{locationId}, #{batchNo}, #{qty}, #{unitCost}, #{totalCost}, #{costMethod}, #{sourceModule}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{inboundOrderId}, #{lastInDate}, 0, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_inventory_cost SET qty = #{qty}, unit_cost = #{unitCost}, total_cost = #{totalCost}, cost_method = #{costMethod}, last_in_date = #{lastInDate}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), inbound_order_id = #{inboundOrderId}, remark = #{remark}, WHERE cost_id = #{costId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT material_id, material_code, MAX(material_name) AS material_name, SUM(qty) AS qty, SUM(total_cost) AS totalCost FROM fin_inventory_cost WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY material_id, material_code ORDER BY material_code
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) FROM fin_inventory_cost WHERE del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_inventory_cost WHERE del_flag = '0'
